name: testsmt11.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (a Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (a Int)(b Int)(RESULT_31 Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.a: ---

(define-fun A.a ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-A this) (a (deref-A this))
  (a (deref-B this)))
)

(define-fun A!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.a: ---

(define-fun B.a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-B this))
)

(define-fun B!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.b: ---

(define-fun B!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.RESULT_31: ---

(define-fun B!RESULT_31 ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT_31 (deref-B this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class A:
; ------------------------

(define-fun A.f ((this Ref)(x Int)) (Tuple2 Int Int)
  (mk-Tuple2 (A.a this) x)
)

(define-fun A!f ((this Ref)(x Int)) (Tuple2 Int Int)
  (mk-Tuple2 (A!a this) x)
)

(define-fun A.g ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (let ((k (A.f this x)))
    (+ (_1 k) (_2 k)))
)

(define-fun A!g ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (let ((k (A!f this x)))
    (+ (_1 k) (_2 k)))
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class B:
; ------------------------

(define-fun B.f ((this Ref)(x Int)) (Tuple2 Int Int)
  (mk-Tuple2 (B.a this) x)
)

(define-fun B!f ((this Ref)(x Int)) (Tuple2 Int Int)
  (mk-Tuple2 (B!a this) x)
)

(define-fun B.g ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (let ((k (B.f this x)))
    (+ (_1 k) (_2 k)))
)

(define-fun B!g ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (let ((k (B!f this x)))
    (+ (_1 k) (_2 k)))
)

(define-fun B.h ((this Ref)(tuple (Tuple2 Int Int))) Int
  (let ((k1 (_1 tuple)))
    (let ((k2 (_2 tuple)))
      (B.g this (+ k1 k2))))
)

(define-fun B!h ((this Ref)(tuple (Tuple2 Int Int))) Int
  (let ((k1 (_1 tuple)))
    (let ((k2 (_2 tuple)))
      (B!g this (+ k1 k2))))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 2) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!b this) 2)
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 2) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun B.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!RESULT_31 this) (B!h this (mk-Tuple2 10 20)))
)

(assert (! (B.inv3 2) :named _xkassert3))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-A (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (b (sel-B (select heap 2))) 2))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (mk-Tuple2 (a (sel-B (select heap 2)))
                      (+ (_1 (mk-Tuple2 10 20)) (_2 (mk-Tuple2 10 20))))))
  (= (RESULT_31 (sel-B (select heap 2))) (+ (_1 a!1) (_2 a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-B (select heap 2))) 1))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  (mk-B 1 2 31))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 (lift-A (mk-A 1)))
       2
       (lift-B (mk-B 1 2 31))))
